storyCards.headline: To Be With You: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Mr. Big's "To Be With You" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 24 weeks on the chart.

To Be With You was released in 1991.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
